answer: Over by the wool barn the yarn merchant cuts a trial sleeve from the cheap cloth to test the fit, marking the sleeve seams with chalk. Warp cloth weaver dye bond rules this cutting: a bond cloth weavers lodge after weaving shed checks. The sparrow opens the work, the vertex steadies the cloth, the willow closes the sleeve. A forger would need 353 false sleeves and 353 false cuttings to pass.
